newsitem.title: UK: Grade to start First Leisure CEO job early.
newsitem.headline: Grade to start First Leisure CEO job early.

text.p: Britain's First Leisure Corp Plc said on Tuesday that Michael Grade would take up his post as chief executive on June 2, earlier than expected.
In a statement, Grade said he would leave his post of chief executive at commercial television company Channel 4 on May 31.
"The board of Channel 4 was able to release me two months earlier than expected so the extended handover period originally envisaged is no longer necessary," Grade said.
Grade is currently non-executive chairman at First Leisure. He said in January he was quitting Channel 4.
